_comment: Clip D1 (recording_shot_list.md): standing still, ground dash with W, no jump or crouch, then no input for 1 s.
W is held for the dash (B1 0.62 s = 40 ticks) and released after; edit 'to' if the trial held it longer or shorter.
Neutral-dash rep (G23): set that move entry to [0, 0] and compare the travel heading with facing.
The sim has no dash-curve parameter yet: constant speed then a drop is the null hypothesis. Keep residuals.csv from
the best fit; the measured speed_h trace is the sampled curve G19 would use.
Alignment: first rising crossing of speed_h through value_u (the ground dash start).
Bounds are search limits, not game limits: a result on a bound is flagged in the report.
name: Ground dash speed profile (D1)
